 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Charlotte Hornets are on the road Sunday afternoon as they travel to take on the Los Angeles Clippers in an interconference matchup.
 Charlotte enters Sunday's game with a 4-8 record after losing on the road to the Phoenix Suns Thursday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Charlotte Hornets guard Coby White (3)Scott Kinser-Imagn Images
 In Thursday's loss, Coby White led the way for the Hornets as he recorded 21 points, three rebounds and three assists while Naz Reid added 16 points, eight rebounds and three assists of his own.
 The Hornets will try to bounce back Sunday as they face off against a struggling Clippers team on the road.
 Los Angeles enters Sunday's contest with a 3-8 record after defeating the Oklahoma City Thunder at home Friday night.
 Los Angeles Clippers center Brook Lopez (11)Brad Penner-Imagn Images
 Brook Lopez led the way for the Clippers in Friday's victory as he ended the game with 26 points, seven rebounds and four assists while Darius Garland recorded 24 points, four rebounds and seven assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Sunday afternoon's matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Hornets Injury Report: Will Brandon Miller Play?
 Charlotte Hornets small forward Brandon Miller (24)Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images
 The Hornets have two players listed on their injury report, though Brandon Miller is not one of them.
 Of course, Miller missed the last two games with a right hip strain but he is off the injury report and will return against the Clippers.
 Charlotte has ruled out Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder as they both remain sidelined while recovering from left hamstring strains.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Clippers Injury Report: Will Brandon Ingram Play?
 Los Angeles Clippers forward Brandon Ingram (7)Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images
 The Clippers have four players listed on their injury report for Sunday, including forward Brandon Ingram.
 Los Angeles has ruled out Ingram as he remains sidelined to begin the season while recovering from right heel surgery and there is still no timetable for his return, though he has been able to ramp up activity in his recovery.
 With Ingram still sidelined, Derrick Jones Jr., Rui Hachimura and Kris Dunn could all continue to have larger roles.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Clippers have also ruled out Bradley Beal (right knee injury management), Jordan Miller (left rotator cuff surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (right Lisfranc surgery).
 Fans can catch Sunday afternoon's matchup between the Hornets and Clippers from the Intuit Dome at 4:30 p.m. ET.
